chunk_findings.detail: The test’s name and docstring promise the B42016bbc0e case: a contended lease whose unit_tests run is only queued (#k on the full-suite lock), not started, must not be yield-requested. The body never queues anything. It calls `RUN.mark_started(repo, "T1", "unit_tests", sha="abc")` and then `heartbeat T1`, so it only covers an already-started run whose pid is this process. A regression that still treats a lock-queued, not-yet-started gate as idle (the case the intent says must not be broken or yield-requested) leaves this assertion green.
